description: MCP server that drives the real Chrome you already use, through an extension and CDP.
name: io.github.LinVireo/browsertap-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Which connected browser an unqualified call targets: chrome, edge or opera. Defaults to whichever registered first.
environmentVariables.name: BROWSERTAP_PREFERRED_BROWSER

environmentVariables.description: Approval profile: lab or safe. Defaults to lab, which skips approval prompts and still enforces the cross-process lock, the quiet-input gate, target activation and on-screen confirmation; safe asks before every physical input.
environmentVariables.name: BROWSERTAP_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Base loopback port for the bridge daemon. Defaults to 18765.
environmentVariables.name: BROWSERTAP_BRIDGE_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the bridge token and runtime state. Defaults to ~/.browsertap.
environmentVariables.name: BROWSERTAP_STATE_DIR

title: BrowserTap MCP
